title: 10 posters you need to see NeurIPS 2026 in Sydney, Atlanta, and Paris
content: If you thought two locations was excessive, this year’s 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing System (NeurIPS 2026) will be taking place across three different locations around the world: Sydney, Australia (Dec. 6-12); Atlanta, U.S. (Dec. 9-13); and Paris, France (Dec. 9-13). Sydney will serve as the main venue of the conference and Atlanta and Paris will serve as the two satellite locations. If you’re looking to connect with world-class scientists in the field of AI and health, here are 10 posters from researchers at the MIT Jameel Clinic that you should check out before you go and where/when to find them.
